answer: Neighbor overlap aging is the mechanism: each agent's recent contact pattern must show low overlap with existing clusters before its messages can ripple beyond a small trial group. Enforcement holds a new identity in that trial group until it keeps three distinct live neighbors for two cycles, so a cloned agent cannot inherit a parent's reach like a shared ember. The per-identity cost is three separate live neighbors plus one small walnut-priced relay fee per cycle, paid anew for every clone.
